screen.rationale: Primary PET photoreforming study in which PET and P25 or P25-Pt are dispersed in 1 M NaOH 'to initiate cleavage of the polymer chain into EG and terephthalate', and light acts on the hydrolysed ethylene glycol (liquid products AA, OA, FA, ethanol from EG); main runs also use a 365 nm LED only (would fail E3), and only the auxiliary solar-simulator (Xe) runs have visible emission; gas and liquid yields are in SI tables.

excluded_observations.what: H2 and CH4 rates (e.g. 2.87 and 15.35 µmol/h H2) under 365 nm LED
excluded_observations.why: UV-only light (E3) on alkaline-hydrolysed PET (E4); absolute values in SI Table S2.

excluded_observations.what: Solar-simulated runs: 0.209 µmol/h H2, 0.009 µmol/h CH4 with P25-Pt
excluded_observations.why: Xe lamp passes E3, but PET is hydrolysed in 1 M NaOH before/during irradiation (E4); rates are of gas evolution, not a product-from-polymer yield with a stated basis.

excluded_observations.what: ~30% of PET valorised to acetic acid; ~20% up-converted (H2)
excluded_observations.why: From EG photoconversion after alkaline hydrolysis (E4); calculations in SI Notes 6-7.
